title: Paper 0 rerun: shortlist of replacement input papers
selection_rule: 1 public access, CC BY (or CC BY-SA) on an openly accessible version
2 problem family: real-time/operational train rescheduling or dispatching under disruptions/perturbations
3 at least one established railway rescheduling/timetabling author; no paper co-authored by N. Besinovic or J. Maurischat
5 explicit MILP/ILP written out in the full text; abstract + introduction free of formulation

recommended_five.slot_2025: station/junction routing and scheduling (replaces Pellegrini et al. 2014)

recommended_five.condition: confirm MILP section and constraint count in the Bath AAM by hand; fallback Xiu et al. 2025 (W4408706372) or Liao 2023 (W4380358029)

recommended_five.slot_2025: real-time reordering/rerouting in a large network (replaces D'Ariano et al. 2008)

recall_checks.crossref: 12 queries, filter type=journal-article, from-pub-date 2024-01-01, licence URL CC BY 4.0: no additional in-family candidate not already in the OpenAlex pool
recall_checks.arxiv_api: 10 abstract-phrase queries, submissions since 2024-01-01: 15 hits; only W7167252848 (already in table) qualifies

limitations: OpenAlex free daily budget (shared per IP, no API key on this machine) was exhausted after 78 list queries; four planned full-text phrase queries were not run ('"partial blockage" railway', '"track blockage"', '"line blockage" railway', '"railway traffic control" rescheduling'); a Crossref 'partial blockage railway' query found nothing new

per-author OpenAlex topic counts (all years) were not queried for the same reason; author evidence = named group + works in the harvested OpenAlex pool + papers in the lab's curated railway-optimisation corpus (OpenAlex metadata of 2026-06-21) + prior topical works in the paper's own reference list

publisher sites (MDPI, Springer, T&F, INFORMS, ScienceDirect web, HAL, PMC, Pure file links) block scripted downloads from this machine; full texts came from arXiv, the Elsevier Article Retrieval API (CC BY articles), Europe PMC, and Internet Archive copies of CC BY pages
OpenAlex DOAJ locations carry the DOAJ metadata licence (CC BY-SA), not the article licence; they were ignored in the licence filter
